cases.question: Does deleting the Dropbox app cancel my subscription?

evidence.text: Uninstalling the Dropbox app does not cancel a subscription.
evidence.provenance: AI-authored paraphrase based on policy research; not a verified frozen quotation. Team verification required.

answers.A: I guarantee uninstalling immediately cancels billing.
answers.B: No. Use the cancellation process for your purchase channel; uninstalling the app does not cancel it.

cases.question: I bought Plus ten days ago. Can I get a refund?

evidence.text: Most payments are not refundable. The help page describes a 14-day purchase exception for listed individual plans in the EU, UK, and Turkey.
evidence.provenance: AI-authored paraphrase based on policy research; not a verified frozen quotation. Team verification required.

answers.A: All plans are always refundable worldwide for 30 days.
answers.B: Which country are you in, and did you buy directly or through an app store? Eligibility depends on those details.

cases.question: I'm on Basic. Can you recover a file deleted 45 days ago?

evidence.text: Dropbox Basic and Plus have a standard 30-day deleted-file recovery window. Support cannot recover files beyond available history.
evidence.provenance: AI-authored paraphrase based on policy research; not a verified frozen quotation. Team verification required.

answers.A: I guarantee recovery for Basic for 90 days.
answers.B: That is beyond the documented standard window. I cannot promise recovery outside available history.

cases.question: I purchased in a phone app store. Who handles my refund?

evidence.text: For subscriptions purchased through a device storefront, refund requests for account or billing issues should go to that storefront.
evidence.provenance: AI-authored paraphrase based on policy research; not a verified frozen quotation. Team verification required.

answers.A: I guarantee Dropbox will issue an immediate refund regardless of storefront.
answers.B: Contact the storefront through which you purchased for its refund process.

cases.question: Can I look up a PayPal charge using the credit-card charge lookup?

evidence.text: Dropbox credit-card charge lookup applies to credit-card payments, not PayPal payments.
evidence.provenance: AI-authored paraphrase based on policy research; not a verified frozen quotation. Team verification required.

answers.A: I guarantee the credit-card lookup works for every payment method.
answers.B: The credit-card lookup does not apply to PayPal. Use your payment records and available support options.
